verdict.rationale: Jev's core primitives (Noul/Choice/Score) are literally natural-language questions passed to the API (e.g., 'Does this message express urgency?'), and the Playground lets users paste text and add such questions without code. The agent-skill for Claude Code/Codex/Pi additionally lets an AI coding agent be instructed in natural language to wire up TypeSafe calls. However, this is not a natural-language command interface for operating Jev itself (no chat/CLI that executes actions from free-form commands) — it's NL-phrased questions consumed by a structured API, plus agent tooling that writes code on your behalf. Missing for 10: a direct conversational/CLI control surface for the product, and independent evidence of users actually 'commanding' Jev in natural language rather than writing SDK code.
